dedupe_keys.name: global health data exchange ghdx ihme catalogue of surveys censuses vital statistics and other health data

description: The Global Health Data Exchange is IHME's catalogue of health-related data, which it describes as the world's most complete catalogue of surveys, censuses, vital statistics and other health data. The Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation maintains it as the source register behind the Global Burden of Disease study. Records describe datasets from national statistics offices, ministries, survey programmes and research projects by country, series and organisation, with links to the original data where it can be obtained, and the site also hosts IHME's own results: GBD estimates, health financing, US county estimates, local and small area estimates and IHME surveys. Coverage is global. The catalogue is free to search; IHME data offered for download can be used by non-commercial users under IHME's free non-commercial user agreement, while third-party data keep their owners' terms. Caveats: it is a catalogue, so many records point to data that need registration or permission elsewhere, and metadata quality varies. Simulation uses: finding health facility surveys, hospital utilisation series and vital statistics to parameterise healthcare demand and vulnerability models in a given country. Related records: the IHME GBD results (data-ihme-gbd-results) are published through it, and the DHS Service Provision Assessments (data-dhs-service-provision-assessment) are among the surveys it lists.
